summary:
S.J. Res. 11 is a joint resolution of congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, the Congressional Review Act. Its operative purpose is to nullify the rule submitted by the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency entitled “Control of Air Pollution From New Motor Vehicles: Heavy-Duty Engine and Vehicle Standards,” published at 88 Fed. Reg. 4296 on January 24, 2023.

The resolution provides that Congress disapproves that EPA rule and that the rule “shall have no force or effect.” It does not amend any provision of the United States Code, establish replacement standards, create new regulatory authority, authorize appropriations, or appropriate funds. Its legal effect, if enacted, would be the disapproval mechanism prescribed by 5 U.S.C. chapter 8 for covered rules submitted to Congress. The text contains no exceptions, conditions precedent beyond enactment of the joint resolution, implementation deadlines, sunset provisions, or effective-date clause.
